verdicts.reason: A: the '30% OFF' headline is shrunk to about the size of its subline, so it no longer leads. 'SUNSET SALE', the legal text and the SUMMER ONLY badge are crammed into the centre on top of the decorative ellipse, the legal copy is unreadable, and the Shop the Sale pill runs off the right edge. B: '30% OFF' is large and clearly dominant, and the subline and badge are grouped neatly below it. But 'SUNSET SALE' is reduced to an illegible speck colliding with the top of the CTA, the legal text is moved under the logo on the left where it sits on the circle at an unreadable size, and the CTA is also cropped at the right edge. B is still the better resize because its headline hierarchy holds.
